notes.title: Nightmare Update COMING TO STEAM!
notes.content: [h3][b]Crime Scene Cleaner launches its first major update “Nightmare Update” July 24, 2025 on Steam![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The nightmares are getting worse. From twisted spaces to blood-soaked rooms, each scene feels like a descent into madness. It's your job to erase every trace – no matter how disturbing...[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="yQZKS9_JpBI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]A big update is coming your way - available on Steam[/b] [b]24th July 2025[/b]. The Challenge Mode “Nightmare” update will contain [b]whole 10 "Nightmare" versions of every currently existing map[/b], featuring [b]new mechanics[/b] and even more thrilling gameplay. Completing these special nightmare maps will reward you with [b]unlockable cosmetics[/b] – special skins – so there’s plenty of incentive to push through the challenge![/p][p][/p][p]Cleaning up after the mafia was never going to be without consequences. The blood, the bodies, the silence, it all left a mark. In the Nightmare Update Kovalsky is haunted by twisted versions of the crime scenes he once scrubbed clean. Nothing is as it was – and he’ll have to face them all over again.[/p][p][/p][p]Think you’ve mastered the art of cleaning? Think again. There’s a new [b]True Cleaner Mode[/b] that strips away all the help – no hints, no cleaner’s instinct, no mercy. Just you, the filth, and your tools. It’s the ultimate challenge for those who believe they can handle the job without leaving a single trace.[/p][p][/p][p][url=https://discord.com/invite/EjHuxvM][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/d017551b346de3df4d7b058bd3ce1177b6620683.png"][/img][/url][/p]

notes.title: Get Ready for the Nightmare Update – Join the Beta!
notes.content:
[p]Sup Cleaners!

You’ve voiced your thoughts and many of you expressed a willingness to help us test new content. And we want to make our community feel special! Let it be a thank-you gift for our most engaged players for waiting so long. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/3b1ad18036ca2993054796846cbc9d73576d16ce.png"][/img]
We know that you’re tired of waiting. And let me tell you… it’s about time. [b]Nightmare [/b]Update is slowly coming to Crime Scene Cleaner! Now you can grab the [b]beta access code[/b] from the news section on our discord server and [b]join the Nightmare Update tests[/b] starting [b]NOW[/b]. Help us find all the bugs and other issues! Your feedback will be invaluable.

The Nightmare Update is our[b] first big update[/b] with new content – and [b]we’re opening up a beta test[/b] for players who want to experience it first.

The update introduces [b]new challenge modes[/b]. Nightmare mode contains whole [b]10 "Nightmare" versions of every currently existing map[/b], featuring [b]new mechanics[/b] and even more thrilling gameplay. Completing these special nightmare maps will reward you with unlockable cosmetics – [b]special skins[/b] – so there’s plenty of incentive to push through the challenge!

[b]How to join Crime Scene Cleaner "Nightmare Update" beta test?[/b] Hop on our [b]discord[/b], the [b]inivitation link is attached to the image below[/b]! That's where you'll find the code and all the important instructions you need.

Be among the first to face the nightmare![/p][h3]
Edit: Beta has ended.
  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/d017551b346de3df4d7b058bd3ce1177b6620683.png"][/img]

[/h3]

notes.title: Roadmap Status Update
notes.content:
Hello Cleaners!

We’re hard at work tackling the points on our [b]roadmap[/b]. While it’s taking some time, rest assured we’re making [b]steady progress[/b] on both the [b]Challenge Modes update [/b]and the [b]upcoming new acts[/b]. That’s why you don’t have to worry, that you will have to wait so much for the next update once again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/92954e4e792376d9dffe4709bb87669b81217deb.png[/img]

[h2]NIGHTMARE MAPS[/h2]
What started as a small addition with Challenge Modes has grown into something much bigger than expected. During development, [b]we decided to take this update to the next level [/b]and make 10 new maps based on the ones you already know from the main campaign. As a result, the Challenge Modes update will now include 1[b]0 "Nightmare" versions of every currently existing map[/b], featuring [b]new mechanics[/b] and even more thrilling gameplay. Each mission that Kovalsky has taken on has left its mark on him, and now you’ll have the chance to delve into his deepest nightmares. These maps uncover the darkest corners of his mind, reimagining familiar crime scenes as [b]twisted versions[/b] of themselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/69170a2d8fe058f81b1f55211dc926cb1a33064d.gif[/img]

[h2]REWARDS[/h2]
Completing these special nightmare maps will [b]reward [/b]you with [b]unlockable cosmetics[/b] – special skins – so there’s plenty of incentive to push through the challenge. These maps aren’t just harder versions of familiar levels. Prepare for new scenarios, new crime scenes, old but new locations with an exciting twist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/e26d068d6eafd7522d62675106f80129ae31c232.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/b5730e2d19c9d12e489a8f5ee6986546324b4c7e.png[/img]
[h2]COMMUNITY VOTED MAP[/h2]
But that’s not all! As promised, we’re also working on something very special: a brand-new mission [b]“Underground Lab”[/b] inspired by the [b]winner of our community contest[/b] on Discord! This mission, designed with input from our amazing fan, is about to become real. Maybe later the winner will share with us how it feels to see his own idea in Crime Scene Cleaner?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/76ae31635a75c33ebe7d065c9c9ab9adb75e2206.gif[/img]

Thank you for your patience and stay tuned for more updates, more crime scenes and more content. And how many cool cosmetics did you find hidden in this post? Let us know!

See ya!
[i]The Devs[/i]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/EjHuxvM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/d017551b346de3df4d7b058bd3ce1177b6620683.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Post-Launch Free Update Roadmap
notes.content:
Sup Cleaners!

Thank you for your incredible support and enthusiasm since the launch of Crime Scene Cleaner! We are so glad for such a warm reception of a game in which we poured our heart and time into. But it’s not the end of our journey and expect more content coming. We're excited to share with you our post-launch roadmap, which outlines the upcoming updates and content you can look forward to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/4459221c10e84af02b05a0e5514fbb9b9b1eaf66.png[/img]

[h2]Phase 1: Hotfixes & QoL[/h2]
Our first priority is to address community feedback and fix common errors reported by our players. We're actively working on hotfixes and quality-of-life improvements to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.

In this phase, we also invite you to report any translation errors you come across. We’re preparing to support community-created translations, so your input will be invaluable in making Crime Scene Cleaner accessible to players around the world. At this moment we are working on traditional chinese translation, but we plan to add more languages (the most requested ones) into the game. So why don’t you push us in the right direction and [b]let us know in discord, if you need any different language to be added?[/b] In the case of not-so-well-known languages, you can contact us directly, because we know from experience that players who know the game are great and can help a lot with localization! 

[h2]Phase 2: Gameplay Update[/h2]
Once the initial fixes are in place, we'll shift our focus to expanding the gameplay experience. We're excited to introduce new [b]Challenge Modes[/b] that will allow you to replay existing missions with new and exciting modifiers. These modes are currently hidden under the "unavailable" tabs, but they will soon be unlocked and ready for you to tackle! Let us know if there are any modifiers you wish to see in these challenges.

[h2]Phase 3: Act II Part 1[/h2]
Finally, we'll be rolling out new content, starting with a [b]Community Voted Map[/b] — a location chosen in a contest a while ago by you, our players! The crime scene idea that won the contest is an Underground Lab, but who knows… there might be something else coming too? After that, get ready for the next chapter in the story with [b]Kovalsky's New Chapter[/b], as this is not the end!

[h2]Phase 4: Act II Part 2[/h2]
And lastly… that’s not the end because[b] Kovalsky's story continues[/b]! Expect thrilling new missions, more narrative elements, and more challenges as the story unfolds.
Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for being a part of the Crime Scene Cleaner! Also, remember to join our discord, if you want to share your experiences with other cleaners like you.

[h2]CONCLUSION[/h2]
No worries, because the entire content from the update roadmap will be [b]a free addition to the full game[/b]! We want to expand the base game, so every update we’ve mentioned here will be available to all players who bought Crime Scene Cleaner at no additional cost. If you already own the game, you’ll be able to hop on Crime Scene Cleaner and experience all the new content without paying a cent more.

On a related note, we’re excited to announce that the [b]official soundtrack for Crime Scene Cleaner will be available for purchase on Steam starting August 27th[/b]! The soundtrack is a way to support our talented musicians who contributed to the game's immersive audio experience. If you’d like to show them some love, grabbing the soundtrack is a great way to do so.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3153150/Crime_Scene_Cleaner_Soundtrack/

Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for being a part of the Crime Scene Cleaner! Also, remember to join our discord, if you want to share your experiences with other cleaners like you.

See ya soon!
[i]The Devs[/i]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/EjHuxvM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/d017551b346de3df4d7b058bd3ce1177b6620683.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devblog #25 - Let The Music Guide You!
notes.content:
Sup Cleaners!

Embarking on a cleaning spree through the gritty underworld can undoubtedly take its toll on your sanity. That's why we've added a feature to make your cleaning escapades a bit more enjoyable – [b]the power of music![/b]

[h2]AUDIO CASSETTES[/h2]

During your adventure, you will be able to find [b]audio cassettes[/b] scattered around the locations. Once you find them, you can [b]add them to your collection[/b], which you can browse through in a [b]special tab located on your tablet[/b]. Moreover, you will be able to [b]play them at any time[/b] you want! Don't be worried, because they won't disturb you in key plot moments of the game. At the start, your library will contain only a few songs, but it will continue to expand with each cassette found.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/b3f35189b54ef11267bcc71fbc22037f4aaccae2.png[/img]
[h2]PLAYLISTS[/h2]

If you hear any music in the game, you can expect it to be findable and playable! [b]Cassettes can be obtained by picking them up during missions[/b], as information about all discovered and undiscovered soundtracks can be found on the tablet. [b]It will also list the location where each specific soundtrack is hidden[/b]. By default, [b]tracks are displayed and sorted [/b]by where they are found, but you can also sort them by title or music genre.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/7bff4b93f07b3f2d54f256c148e7de703fac15dd.png[/img]

But that's not all, because [b]you can create your own playlists[/b]! Select songs you want to hear the most, [b]press the play button[/b] and enjoy your favorite songs one after another as long as you want. Now, go out there, clean up the mess, and let the music guide you.

Stay tuned for more updates, and once you get a hold on the game, don't forget to share your favorite cleaning beats with us! And what do you usually listen to while cleaning in real life? Let us know through discord or in the comments! Have a happy time cleaning to your favorite tunes and remember to keep your eyes wide open for news and dates, because we’re getting closer and closer to the release, which is just around the corner. Get ready because we’re progressing at full speed, cleaners!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/d834c5fc1c5984cdfbbf1243fa74c08e6f0883df.png[/img]
And by the way, you can let us know in the comment what could have possibly happened on the picture above. We only accept wrong answers!

See ya!
[i]The Devs[/i]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/EjHuxvM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/d017551b346de3df4d7b058bd3ce1177b6620683.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devblog #24 - Washing Stains
notes.content:
Sup Cleaners!
We hope that you remember who your best friends are at the crime scene. Although people can be tricky, your cleaning tools are to be trusted, especially when it comes to fighting your biggest enemy – general mess and… lots of blood stains. In this kind of job, you have to become like a tactician on the battlefield. Recognize the problem and tackle it with the best weapon available. 

[h2]STAIN TYPES[/h2]
Now every stain is a different story. You will find some stains on the carpet, furniture, wooden floor or on glass and that makes your job even more interesting. [b]Each type of surface poses a different challenge. Some stains are harder to get rid of[/b] and if you don’t want to spend all day cleaning just one stain, you will need to come up with an idea to take care of it in a smart way. 

[h2]DIFFERENT STAIN, DIFFERENT TOOL[/h2]
Let’s dive into details. For example, cleaning glasses now gets tricky – they are fragile and will break if you use a power washer on them. It forces you later to take out the trash can to clean up the mess you’ve just made. Even more work to do! Mop may not break glasses but will surely throw them all around the place. [b]Sponge is a safe option[/b] here. The glasses will not only be clean, but also won’t budge by an inch. That’s it, precise cleaners! By implementing different types of stains, [b]we expanded the usability of already existing tools[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/ce6d8071705f50d5c43d0289fff8bd1e18337a64.gif[/img]

Do you use a mop to clean your carpet in real life? Yeah… you probably don’t and we neither. The correct answer, again, is to use a sponge! For real, give this man some credit… You will be wasting your time if you just pull out a mop or a power washer, but most importantly… you don’t want to make your lovely sponge sad, do you? That’s the sponge’s time to shine! Use it to scrub the carpet at a much better speed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/dbbdd340e50ca361c05b81624263daaa4e06efa9.gif[/img]

[h2]REARRANGING FURNITURE[/h2]
Did you know that [b]items don’t really like to be cleaned with a mop[/b]? Well… your mop was born for different purposes, like cleaning floors and other flat surfaces. To properly wash stains on items and not to fall into the depths of despair from your cushions flying all around the place, again, you should pick a sponge. This will be crucial to your cleaning struggles because [b]you won’t be able to arrange the furniture properly with its elements being dirty.[/b] First, you need to clean a cushion of all the blood before you try to put it back on the sofa. Only then will it count as completed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/61be36002c2dd7e08051fcaf6d2f32ce02ce9d5d.gif[/img]

And what do you guys think? Do tools now make more sense to you? And most importantly… how do you like the sponge's glow up, tempting beast isn’t it? (pls stop hating on sponge, it has feelings) Well, let us know what improvements to your cleaning struggles you would like to see in the future!

See ya!
[i]The Devs[/i]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/EjHuxvM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/d017551b346de3df4d7b058bd3ce1177b6620683.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devblog #23 - Safe Mode
notes.content:
Sup Cleaners!
It’s been some busy time, but trust us – we are not lowering the tempo. During their job, every cleaner is bound to see many gruesome images. After all, crimes can sound tempting and sweet, but there’s no denying that their main theme is a bloody red color. For some reasons, you may prefer to save yourself from those murderous views and, for those of you, we have a solution. 

[h2]SAFE MODE[/h2]
You heard us right! We’ve implemented a safe mode option. But how does it work exactly, huh? Although this option doesn’t fully erase crimes (well, that's a game about cleaning them after all lol), it turns them into family-friendly content. 

All the places, usually running with blood, will now remind you more of a paintball battlefield. [b]Safe mode turns blood into paint and cleans bodies from bloody wounds[/b], so it seems as if the victims are just peacefully sleeping.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/53c601ad8fd626d4410bcb97cf4f75f92ca7e072.png[/img]
To turn on/off the safe mode, just go [b]open the settings[/b] → general → blood settings. There you can adjust the blood settings to a full or safe mode. After you finish, [b]remember to apply changes.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/d575b56a430970662824c348e786742baecf6ac0.gif[/img]

Why would we include such a feature in our game? Well, first of all, we want to give a helping hand to content creators, who prefer or need to censor their content for a bunch of reasons, such as website’s politics, young audience and so on. Safe mode is optional, so don’t worry if it will ruin your experience – it’s just a matter of preferences. If someone doesn’t really like the sight of blood and other cruelties, it’s also an option for those people. 

Do you, perhaps, have in mind any other settings option that could be useful in our game, that is not already included in [i]Crime Scene Cleaner[/i]? Will you use a safe mode or prefer it all to run with blood? Let us know in the comments or on our discord server! 

See ya!
[i]The Devs[/i]

notes.title: Devblog #22 - Beast's adjustments
notes.content:
Sup Cleaners!
You’ve been introduced to this beast once, but since then some things have changed. The one and only power washer is there to shine again among all the other cleaning tools. Remember that overpowered character from your favorite cartoon? Yeah, that’s him… kinda. And just a friendly reminder: this machine will be crucial in cleaning outdoor spaces, but is way too strong for indoor use. One can never be too careful!

[h1]POWER WASHER MODES[/h1]
Changing nozzles will let you adjust the flow of the water stream in a way that will suit you better at the moment, based on the shape of bloodstains you are about to clean. There are two ways to go – vertical and horizontal. If washing gets uncomfortable or inefficient, try out the other mode as it might turn out to be a real help. You can switch in between these two options at any time! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/1d2587303cdae0eb59def194e9530ab9eb99dcef.gif[/img]

You should be aware of the devastating power this machine holds. Some items may be found too fragile to withstand it! Then, instead of fulfilling your cleaning duty, you will be making even more mess. And sometimes… there’s no time for such mistakes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/fb42d03c88437432dc5572252258d6b54e363779.gif[/img]

For the power washer to not be too overpowered, its power was limited to a specific range. After placing the machine, there is a limit to how far away you can walk away with the nozzle. UI elements will tell you once you get too far from it. And if you ever wondered about this ugly popup we’ve presented to you before – fear not, dear cleaners. It wasn’t the final product, as the captions look way better now. See for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/ec67e8ffc55f1ddee33ca3a16cb684bd2a8b26b6.png[/img]
Psst… we’ve also fixed a typo! And maybe have added some new ones… Let’s see if you can find them. As you can see for yourself, we are constantly improving the game's features, even those already implemented. Let us know in the comments or on our discord server, if you’ve got any ideas what other things the power washer should be able to do! 

See ya!
[i]The Devs[/i]

notes.title: Devblog #15 - The "Interior Designer" Update
notes.content:
Hello Cleaners!
It’s renovation time! Proper cleanup does not only mean collecting trash or washing up floors and walls. Once the mayhem of a crime happens, there will be some furniture you must move around. These could be a sign of struggle or victims’ attempts to hide.  

At the beginning of some missions, you may receive photos which will guide you in cleaning up misplaced furniture. Miscellaneous things should be returned to their spots, so no one can even suspect that anything has happened before. Sometimes you will have to use your own imagination and cleaning sense to make sure everything is in the right spot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/f0a26417f04ea2b88292ab181b7d6cf1005c3128.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/733fb6dc176cbfdb130e3353a3d7da5b3712448f.jpg[/img]

Luckily, you don’t have to worry about perfectly recreating the pictures, coherent look is key. If you find random chairs in the middle of the room, make sure to find which table has an unfinished set. The same goes for other larger objects such as drawers or wardrobes. Every cabinet has to have a full set of drawers and stand in roughly the same place. So before you move on to another room, make sure everything is neat and as clean as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/50acd87a26aaae9644fb7af0bbd52ae3b330f0c5.gif[/img]

Unfortunately, not every piece of furniture can be simply picked up and placed in its rightful spot. There are those which are too big to simply throw away, in that case, you will be forced to dismantle them into smaller pieces, so they can fit in your van more easily. Luckily you have your powerful fists! Break the old furniture to make space for potentially new! The house owner will thank you later! If they are still alive that is... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/145aeefb3539e62b417d771bc2c7cd01db0b306e.gif[/img]

These small renovations may be some of the final things you do on the crime scene, so check every corner carefully before you leave. It would be unprofessional to leave the house you just spent time cleaning and renovating in a state of disarray. Hopefully, you enjoy a bit of house decor and macabre renovations. Let us know what you think about this element of cleaning up. We’re awaiting your feedback here in the comments, on our social media and in our discord.

See you next time!
[url=https://discord.gg/FXbMXtJpae][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/d017551b346de3df4d7b058bd3ce1177b6620683.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devblog #7 - Don't Leave a Bloody Mess
notes.content:
Hello Cleaners!
We know you are ready to clean after criminals, but you have to be careful about the mess you may make. Splashing dirty water on the scene will be problematic, so be mindful of where you swing that mop. Blood is sticky and everything can get covered by it, even you!

[b]We prepared a multitude of blood splatters and divided them into 5 different origins:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/bd473639fee2fdd130d918fb973209c8f45a9fa7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Dropping splatters[/b] - picking up objects and dropping them on the floor will leave markings, which you will later have to clean. 
[*] [b]Dragging smudges[/b] - when you move bodies or drag blood-covered furniture, you will leave blood marks behind. 
[*] [b]Throwing spots [/b]- thrown items will also leave blood behind, so be mindful of leaving trails when moving things around. 
[*] [b]Dripping spots[/b] -  carrying objects covered in blood leaves little spots of blood on the floor. Remember that this also applies to your own equipment. Once your mop becomes dirty, it will leave small drops behind. 
[*] [b]Bloody footsteps[/b] - be careful where you walk! Wherever you accidentally step into a blood puddle, your shoes will be dirty and you take will leave footsteps all over the place.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/a924ea3b67628d183183047253a676bf18a93cfb.gif[/img]

Every origin will have a set of variations, which will adapt themselves to your actions. They will change directions, shapes and sizes depending on the objects you carry around and the way you handle them. Cleaning your own blood splatters and footsteps is just as important as removing evidence. 

As usual, we're waiting for your feedback! Let us know what other blood marks we should consider via our Discord or social media!

[url=https://discord.gg/FXbMXtJpae][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34613706/d017551b346de3df4d7b058bd3ce1177b6620683.png[/img][/url]
